mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and potential inflation, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -0.5% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO MoM and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal (PAYEMS MoM > 0.1% and UNRATE MoM < 0) does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) combined with an increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending from housing to other sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal (HOUST MoM < 0 and RSAFS MoM > 0) does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased liquidity.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 0.5% does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals a growing economy, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
